newsitem.title: USA: Philadelphia pension fund to divest Texaco.
newsitem.headline: Philadelphia pension fund to divest Texaco.

text.p: The city of Philadelphia's pension board voted to divest $5.5 million worth of Texaco Inc stock, citing evidence of racial bias at the oil company.
"People are very offended as to what was revealed on the Texaco tapes, and we don't want to be part of that corporate culture," pension board Chairman Ben Hayllar said at a board meeting.

He was referring to tape recordings of discussions among Texaco executives that were laced with racial slurs. The tapes came to light in connection with a racial discrimination lawsuit filed against Texaco by six black employees.
